evidence.title: Agility Robotics Evolves Executive Leadership Team to Support Next Phase of Growth as a Public Company
evidence.excerpt: SALEM, Ore., November 18, 2026 — Agility ™ (Nasdaq: AGLT), a leading humanoid robotics and physical AI company, today announced three executive leadership appointments to support its public company operations and sharpen its focus on growth. Daniel Diez, previously Chief Business Officer, has been promoted to President. Christopher “Sully” Sullivan, who joined Agility in May as Vice President of Customer Success, has been appointed Chief Product Officer. Ana Lang, previously Chief Legal & People Officer, has been named Chief Administrative Officer. The appointments follow the company’s November 4 completion of its business combination with Churchill Capital Corp XI and its listing on Nasdaq, and come amid significant commercial and product momentum following the unveiling of Digit 5 in September, including an expanded deployment agreement with GXO, a planned pilot with AGCO and paid evaluation programs with three additional enterprise manufacturing customers announced in October. “Daniel and Ana are leaders I’ve trusted for years, well before they joined Agility, and they’ve built the commercial strategy and the legal and organizational foundation that helped bring us to the public
